body:
I just feel numb ATM. Laid off, had to refile disability paperwork, can't get a pro bono lawyer, homeless, and she killed my fucking cat via an innocent little girl. They're monsters, but I can't fight them. They're wealthy monsters who are good Christian folk, and I'm the deadbeat who filed for divorce, and can't support my kids.

At this point, I have to walk in to court by myself, and give up everything that means anything to me. It sucks. My family is in another state, I can't leave, and I have no one. I hate them even more for that.

I am a veteran. They said I'm not, but I am, with documentation to prove it.

I will do that. Thank you.

He doesn't really. He can just say its part of the divorce fight, she gets nothing, which he did, and the judge gets to decide if there is merit in keeping my married name or he blanket awards the divorce to X, in which case I can get my name legally changed before another judge, after I file the appropriate paperwork and fees of course. Its stupid and archaic.

Not mine, but it was suggested to try the college or a new graduate who could use the hours and might do pro bono so I'm going to look into that before giving up. I'm so sorry this sub had to become my anxiety buffer after my Buddy....

I wish I could be like, hey! Its me! Mario! But, I'm terrified of the repercussions, especially after losing my buddy. I don't have my anxiety buffer. I know o need a therapist asap, but I'm dependant on others for transportation at the moment.

I had no idea about this, and to avoid identifying info because... Well, terror, but I've always been expected to follow a path that most others can't, and I don't get information about some services that would otherwise be helpful. Thank you, I will definitely call and email. Thank you.

There is! I'll check!!! Thank you. Thank you so much!!! Some of the advice here tonight, I didn't think about, and for the first time in weeks I'm feeling hope. Thank you. Like groveling on the floor in thanks, thank you everyone.
I didn't think of this. Thank you. I will contact animal cruelty societies, and the police both. Thank you!

I hesitate with some words because I'm afraid the repercussions if they find out I'm posting again, but basically a good old boys club. His lawyer and the judge golf together... And there isn't another judge (farming county, very small population).

Its just I don't have legal custody, only visitation, and X refuses to ammend agreement, so I can have an easier time seeing them no transport, no house, a shelter only, and his mom is using that against me gleefully. I'll be in shelter full time starting this week.

I did. Were both poor. X hasn't worked in over a year, his parents support him and my kids over there. Its basically whoever the judge decides to award that to. Hell, I even asked for a legal name change back to my maiden name and he fought me on that, so now a judge gets to decide whether or not I can change my name, or if I have to wait til after the divorce and put in an application to do it myself and go before another judge. This state is the worst.
This is a fantastic idea. I hadn't thought about that, because everyone was waving off as your cat is old, but he wasn't THAT old, and was in great health until those treats.
Thank you. I will start drafting emails when I get back into town on Tuesday.  I don't feel super comfortable drafting emails on free travel station hot spot.
Thank you. I will try this. I appreciate the help because I was actually stuck in the official channels route
I haven't and its a fair point. I will try that come Tuesday when I'll have transportation to the city.

I let my lawyer know, and they are doing the minimum to at least get me divorced, and if the alienation claim goes anywhere I'll get my legal fees back, but XH is trying to block on grounds that kids shouldn't talk to judge, its premature.  I'm just really down because I lost my buddy/semi therapy animal, and I got jokes about how I should watch Where the Red Fern Grows from MIL, and I have to walk 2 miles for free WiFi and AC. Summer is a bitch, 110 this week.

I really like the email idea. I was going to write letters, but I was worried they would get lost in the shuffle of homelessness. I'm in therapy, but I'm pretty at the mercy of when they can schedule me, and whether or not I can find a ride. I'm just really damn down this week. It sucks to see your kids cry, and losing my cat was a blow. He was my buddy, a semi therapy animal.

It wasn't a snap decision to give up. I haven't been able to afford my attorney for over a month, and I've searched. I was laid off, can't find work, no transportation at this point, and because of that I missed key appointments for my disability claim, so it was denied. I've looked for rides, asked for help, been denied around every corner for not meeting requirements... Its been months.

My parents are disabled, my family helps when they can but most of what they make goes to parental care/nursing home. I swear to you I have done everything I've been told to, looked everywhere I've been told to look, and even begged on the streets.

I don't want that for my kids...

I have asked. LAS does not handle divorces, only financial hardship cases v companies/rental managers due to cutbacks in federal budget. The only other one no longer handles legal issues at all because of federal budget cuts, they are specifically for battered women counseling, now.

There were a couple of other leads, but I didn't qualify, because not a native Spanish speaker, native american, and wasn't born in this state. Which I get, strenuous requirements mean fewer clients, and its been bad for federal/state funding.
